mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.

acceptedEvidence.claim: The complete source-topology dependency is promoted and ready for non-mutating classification.
Current branch and remote source authority are recorded.

allowedReads: Pending path names and Git statuses
Repository ignore rules and tracked diffs
Bounded metadata and content of candidate durable files for privacy and secret-risk classification
exclusions: No deletion, reset, clean, move, rename, checkout, merge, or source-content edit
Do not print or copy discovered secret values
Do not classify raw model output as publishable without sanitization
acceptanceGate: Every durable candidate has a reason and intended destination.
oneFixPlan: Identify each durable candidate, owner, reason, destination, and required sanitization without changing pending work.
validationCommand: Compare classification paths to a fresh status set and require owner, reason, destination, and privacy disposition for every durable candidate.
cancellationRule: Stop before cleanup, transfer, or any ambiguous destructive classification.
